meta.title: About Haali Health — Closing the information gap in chronic care
meta.description: Haali Health was created to make the period between appointments more visible, structured and clinically useful for healthcare providers across Saudi Arabia and the GCC.

hero.title: Closing the information gap in chronic care.
body: People live with chronic conditions every day, while clinical care is often organised around individual appointments.
What happens between those appointments — changes in symptoms, medication use, self-management, wellbeing and new concerns — can remain difficult for clinical teams to see.
Haali Health was created to make that period more visible, structured and clinically useful.

mission.title: Care is continuous. Clinical information should be too.
body: Chronic care does not stop when a patient leaves an appointment.
Haali helps healthcare providers maintain structured contact with patients before and between visits, turning what patients report into information that clinical teams can review and use.
The aim is not to replace the consultation. It is to help make sure the consultation — and the care between consultations — starts with a better picture of what has actually been happening.
mission.pullQuote: We are not trying to replace the consultation. We are trying to make sure the clinical team has more of the patient story when it matters.

philosophy.title: Three principles we will not compromise on.
philosophy.subtitle: These are design principles that shape how Haali is built.

cards.title: Clinicians remain in control.
cards.body: Haali can gather, clarify and structure patient-reported information, but clinical judgement stays with authorised healthcare professionals. AI should extend the clinical team's ability to follow patients — not take clinical decisions away from them.

cards.title: Access should be low-friction.
cards.body: Technology should make follow-up easier for patients, not introduce another barrier. Haali is designed around a familiar interaction: answering a telephone call and having a natural conversation, without requiring a patient app, portal account or new digital routine.
cards.point: Technology should reduce barriers, not create them.

cards.title: Care should be understood longitudinally.
cards.body: An individual encounter provides one point in time. Chronic-care decisions often depend on understanding what is changing between those encounters. Haali is designed to build a structured longitudinal view of what patients report over time.
cards.point: See the trajectory, not only the encounter.

regional.title: Built around the healthcare environment it is intended to serve.
regional.body: Haali is being developed from the Saudi healthcare context outward rather than taking a generic product and changing the interface for a new market. That influences the clinical content, language experience, workflow, interoperability approach and deployment requirements behind the platform.

points.title: Saudi-first clinical design
points.body: Haali's initial Type 2 Diabetes pathway is being developed around approved Saudi clinical guidance and the requirements of provider-led chronic-care follow-up. Clinical pathways can then be adapted and governed for the market and organisation in which they are deployed.

points.title: Arabic and English by design
points.body: Haali is designed for natural patient conversations in Arabic and English, including the realities of conversational and mixed-language communication. Language capability is treated as part of the clinical experience, not simply as interface translation.

points.title: Designed to extend across the GCC
points.body: The underlying platform is intended to support deployment across GCC healthcare systems while allowing clinical, regulatory, integration, hosting and operational requirements to be configured market by market. Saudi first. GCC by design.

extensibility.title: Starting deliberately narrow, engineered to go wide.
extensibility.body: Haali is starting with Type 2 Diabetes — a chronic-care pathway where regular follow-up, medication use, patient-reported concerns and longitudinal outcomes are particularly important. Starting with one pathway allows the clinical workflow, safety model, patient conversation and structured outputs to be developed and validated with appropriate depth before the platform expands.
extensibility.note: Future pathways are subject to clinical development, validation and provider priorities.

phases.title: Type 2 Diabetes
phases.body: Pre-appointment information gathering · between-visit follow-up · medication adherence · patient-reported symptoms and concerns · pathway measures · clinician review

phases.title: Additional chronic-care pathways
phases.body: The same underlying follow-up model can be configured for additional chronic conditions as new pathways are clinically developed and validated.

phases.title: Recovery and longer-term follow-up
phases.body: The architecture is also designed to support other structured follow-up use cases where longitudinal patient-reported information can improve visibility between clinical encounters.

why.title: The appointment should not be the only time the patient becomes visible.
body: Haali Health is focused on a simple problem: healthcare teams are responsible for patients over time, but much of the information available to them is still captured at isolated moments.

We believe routine patient follow-up can become part of the clinical information infrastructure rather than remaining dependent on repeated manual calls, disconnected questionnaires or information that never reaches the care team in a structured form.

Haali is being built to help close that gap — combining low-friction patient conversations, structured clinical information, clinician oversight and longitudinal measurement in one continuous workflow.
why.closing: Better visibility between appointments. Better information when clinical teams need it.

meta.title: Privacy Policy — Haali Health Ltd
meta.description: How Haali Health Ltd collects and uses personal information when you visit the Haali Health website, contact us or request a demonstration.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: Haali Health Ltd respects your privacy and is committed to handling personal information responsibly and transparently.

privacy.disclaimer: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect and use personal information when you visit the Haali Health website, contact us, request a demonstration or otherwise interact with Haali Health Ltd in a business context. It primarily covers information for which Haali Health Ltd determines why and how it is used. When Haali is deployed by a healthcare provider to process patient information, additional provider-specific privacy and data-processing arrangements will apply.

callout.title: Healthcare-provider deployments
callout.body: When Haali Health is deployed by a healthcare provider to process real patient information, additional provider-specific privacy and data-processing arrangements will apply. These will be agreed with the healthcare organisation before real patient data is processed.

sections.title: 1. Who we are and scope
body: Haali Health Ltd operates the Haali Health website and is responsible for the personal information described in this Privacy Policy.
This policy applies to information collected through:
bullets: the Haali Health website;
demo and contact forms;
direct business enquiries and email communications;
interactions with Haali Health representatives; and
essential website, technical and security logs.
after: This policy does not by itself govern all processing of patient health information undertaken when Haali is deployed by a hospital, clinic or other healthcare provider. Those arrangements will be governed by the relevant provider-specific privacy information, contractual terms and Data Processing Agreement.

sections.title: 2. Information we collect
body: When you request a demonstration or contact Haali, we may collect:
bullets: full name — required;
hospital or organisation — required;
professional email address — required;
role or job title — required;
area of interest or other information you choose to provide — optional; and
correspondence with Haali Health Ltd.
after: Please do not submit patient health information through the website contact or demo-request forms.

The website may also generate limited technical information necessary to operate and secure the service, such as IP address, browser/device information, date and time of access and technical or security logs.
If you do not provide information marked as required, we may be unable to respond to your enquiry or arrange a demonstration.

sections.title: 3. Why we use your information and legal basis
body: We use personal information to:
bullets: respond to enquiries;
arrange and conduct demonstrations;
communicate with prospective healthcare organisations, partners and other business contacts;
operate, maintain and secure the website;
investigate technical or security issues;
maintain appropriate business records; and
comply with applicable legal or regulatory obligations.
after: Depending on the circumstances, we process personal information with your consent, where processing is necessary for a lawful legitimate interest that does not override your rights and interests, to implement an agreement to which you are a party, to comply with applicable law, or on another legal basis permitted by applicable data-protection law.

Submitting a demo request or business enquiry does not subscribe you to an unrelated marketing mailing list. If Haali Health Ltd introduces direct marketing in future, we will implement the consent and opt-out controls required by applicable law before doing so.

sections.title: 4. Who we share information with and where it is processed
body: Haali Health Ltd may use service providers that support the operation of the website and our business, such as website hosting, form-processing, business email, cybersecurity or professional-services providers.

Website and demo/contact-form information is processed and stored using: [DEVELOPER MUST INSERT THE ACTUAL WEBSITE/FORM HOSTING PROVIDER, PROCESSING LOCATION(S), AND WHETHER PROCESSING OCCURS INSIDE OR OUTSIDE SAUDI ARABIA].

Where personal information is transferred, disclosed or processed outside Saudi Arabia and the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law applies, Haali Health Ltd will apply the requirements and safeguards required by applicable law.
We may also disclose personal information where required by law, a competent regulatory authority, a court or another legally authorised body.

sections.title: 5. How long we keep information
body: Haali Health Ltd retains personal information only for as long as it is reasonably required for the purpose for which it was collected and for any applicable legal, regulatory, contractual or legitimate business record-keeping requirement.

For website enquiries and demonstration requests, this generally means retaining the information while the enquiry or potential business relationship remains active and thereafter only for as long as reasonably necessary for those purposes.
When personal information is no longer required, it will be securely deleted, destroyed or anonymised as appropriate.

sections.title: 6. Security
body: Haali Health Ltd uses organisational and technical measures intended to protect personal information against unauthorised access, loss, alteration, disclosure or misuse.

The measures used depend on the nature of the information and the relevant technical environment. Further information about Haali's approach to access control, encryption, auditability, deployment requirements and assurance is available in Security & Governance.
No internet or information system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.title: 7. Your privacy rights
body: Depending on the applicable law and circumstances, you may have rights relating to your personal information, including rights to:
bullets: be informed about the legal basis and purpose for collecting your information;
access personal information held about you;
obtain a readable copy of personal information held about you;
request correction, completion or updating of inaccurate information;
request destruction of personal information where applicable; and
withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
after: To exercise a right relating to information controlled by Haali Health Ltd, contact us at info@haalihealth.com.

If Haali processes patient information solely on behalf of a healthcare provider, that provider will ordinarily be the primary point of contact for requests relating to that patient information, and Haali will support the provider as required by the applicable arrangement and law.

sections.title: 8. Website technologies
body: The Haali Health website may use technical functionality and server logs necessary to operate, secure and maintain the website.
Haali Health Ltd does not currently use non-essential analytics, advertising pixels or behavioural tracking technologies.
If this changes, we will update this Privacy Policy and implement any required consent or preference controls before introducing those technologies.

sections.title: 9. Contact and complaints
body: If you have a question about this Privacy Policy, want to exercise a privacy right or wish to raise a privacy concern, contact:
Haali Health Ltd — info@haalihealth.com
Where the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law applies, you may also have the right to raise a complaint with the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA) in accordance with the applicable complaint process.

sections.title: 10. Changes to this Privacy Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes to our website, services, processing activities, technologies or applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
The current version and its last-updated date will be published on this page.
